case_brief.incident_description: Lerato was a regional sales coordinator employed for three years. In August she was told that her sales figures were below target. She says the targets had been increased by 35% while two vacancies in her team remained unfilled. She was never placed on a formal performance improvement plan. She had two coaching meetings over three weeks but no written improvement plan, no agreed milestones and no additional resources. She was dismissed for poor performance after the second coaching meeting.
case_brief.original_client_narrative: My targets went up 35 percent while we were two people short. They called two meetings coaching but I never got a PIP or clear plan. Three weeks later they fired me for poor performance.
case_brief.recommended_next_step: WP letter challenging the adequacy of the performance-management process and the fairness of dismissal.
weaknesses: Employer had raised performance concerns before dismissal
